issues.on_page: Fund balances - September 30, 2024 460,590 / 2025 508,583 (modified cash basis); balance sheet p4 cash and equivalents total 508,312 with (271) payroll withholding liability
issues.issue: Fund balances are stored as beginning/ending cash. ending_cash 508,583 is a fund balance; the cash actually printed on p4 is 508,312. Because basis is 'cash', proprietary is null even though the proprietary cash flow statement is on p8 (operating 322,447; noncapital 1,562; capital and related (373,733); investing (55,642); cash 1,096,449 to 991,083). Randolph_FY2025 is laid out the same way by the same auditor and was recorded as GAAP with proprietary filled, so the two reports are treated inconsistently. The extractor explained this in notes.

issues.on_page: Grants 43,852 (capital grants and contributions, Environment and leisure, p3)
issues.issue: The same label 'Grants' is donations/contributions here but intergovernmental/state aid at receipts[16], although the rules say one label gets one category. The grantor isn't stated, so either category is defensible.

issues.on_page: Grants 1,345,113 (nonoperating); p3 Capital Grants and Contributions 1,345,113; p8 Grant proceeds received 1,219,296 under capital financing
issues.issue: This is a Water Fund capital grant. The rules allow capital contributions in business_type.other_financing instead of receipts. The page prints it as nonoperating revenue, so the current treatment is defensible.

issues.on_page: Cemetery column; statement function Environment and leisure
issues.issue: The rules list cemetery under health/welfare. The extractor used culture/recreation so the function split ties to the statement's Environment and leisure line (141,435), and that does tie. This is a judgment call.

issues.on_page: Sanitation column 58,962 = General Fund Public works 58,962
issues.issue: Sanitation (refuse) is recorded under streets/highways so it ties to the Public works line. Defensible, but it is refuse collection, not streets.

issues.on_page: Capital outlay 23,625 (Administrative); also detail[45] 8,823 Police, detail[68] 4,911 Cemetery, detail[78] 47,788 Park
issues.issue: The object of these capital outlay lines isn't printed, so 'construction/infrastructure' is a guess (police capital outlay is more likely equipment). Randolph's identical lines use 'not itemized'. Lines are already marked review.
Sales tax collected and owed to the state could be 'due to other governments'.
